main.description: Circle metadata, authored by the Space authority into its own permissioned repo. The only Catbird-specific record type in a Circle; posts and likes are unmodified Bluesky records.

circleId.description: Stable Circle identity, independent of the Space key. Survives migration to a different Space, which is the only identifier that does.

migratedFrom.description: The Space this Circle's content was migrated from, if any.

migratedTo.description: The Space this Circle's content was migrated to, if any. Set when the Circle has moved and this Space is retained read-only.
